raw: [name="Eblana"]The Nachzehrer, Nezzsalem. He who calls himself the lord of war and death.
speaker: Eblana
content: The Nachzehrer, Nezzsalem. He who calls himself the lord of war and death.

raw: [name="'The Brigadier'"]The Sarkaz Royal Court sure has a thing for these overblown titles.
speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: The Sarkaz Royal Court sure has a thing for these overblown titles.

speaker: Eblana
content: Overblown...? Hardly.

raw: [name="Eblana"]He just happens to be ancient enough.
speaker: Eblana
content: He just happens to be ancient enough.

raw: [name="Eblana"]But, he is not the only living legend here.
speaker: Eblana
content: But, he is not the only living legend here.

speaker: 'The Brigadier'
content: Why of course!

raw: Not far away, naval guns roar.
content: Not far away, naval guns roar.

raw: Ancient witchcraft is not the only force that can cause mountains to move.
content: Ancient witchcraft is not the only force that can cause mountains to move.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Now, let us pit war against war... and death against death.
speaker: Eblana
content: Now, let us pit war against war... and death against death.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Sudaram"]My Patriarch, the hunt has been cut short.
speaker: Sudaram
content: My Patriarch, the hunt has been cut short.

raw: [name="Sudaram"]That Draco's flames have broken our formation.
speaker: Sudaram
content: That Draco's flames have broken our formation.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: ...Draco.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Thousands of years ago, after the Sarkaz first lost their homeland, they once did battle against a red dragon on this very soil.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Thousands of years ago, after the Sarkaz first lost their homeland, they once did battle against a red dragon on this very soil.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Those flames turned fields of Sarkaz into charred stone. They are still beside us, and beneath our feet.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Those flames turned fields of Sarkaz into charred stone. They are still beside us, and beneath our feet.

speaker: Sudaram
content: We will slay her.

raw: [name="Sudaram"]A red dragon will sate our appetite for a while.
speaker: Sudaram
content: A red dragon will sate our appetite for a while.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]She is not the one who drives this war.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: She is not the one who drives this war.

raw: The Nachzehrer King turns his gaze towards a certain part of the battlefield.
content: The Nachzehrer King turns his gaze towards a certain part of the battlefield.

raw: Behind the Red Dragon's smoke and flames, a huge shadow is rushing toward them at an unexpected speed.
content: Behind the Red Dragon's smoke and flames, a huge shadow is rushing toward them at an unexpected speed.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]A titan that casts a shadow across the land, able to shake mountains and rivers with but a single breath–
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: A titan that casts a shadow across the land, able to shake mountains and rivers with but a single breath–

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]No longer is it a mere red dragon.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: No longer is it a mere red dragon.
'All parameters set!'
'Loading complete!'
'Firing interference shells!'
'Target locked on–'
'Main guns, first salvo!'

speaker: Flag Officer
content: Confirmed hit!

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]General, we've swept the obstacles away.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: General, we've swept the obstacles away.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Good.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Gastrell, all ahead full.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Our objective – the Nachzehrer's throne.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Our objective – the Nachzehrer's throne.
The naval guns roar.

raw: Wellington is well-acquainted with his most loyal subject – the oldest gun aboard the ship, that which assisted him in blowing open the gates of Lingones.
content: Wellington is well-acquainted with his most loyal subject – the oldest gun aboard the ship, that which assisted him in blowing open the gates of Lingones.

raw: He killed the mightiest nomadic city on Terra. He pulled the spine from its corpse and made it a part of his warship.
content: He killed the mightiest nomadic city on Terra. He pulled the spine from its corpse and made it a part of his warship.

raw: Afterwards, he took the Gastrell to many lands, and conquered many foes.
content: Afterwards, he took the Gastrell to many lands, and conquered many foes.

raw: The Arts orbs of Leithanian casters, the shields of Ursine vanguards, the golden blades of Sargonian assassins – he collected and modified the most valuable components of his enemies, and placed them upon his flagship.
content: The Arts orbs of Leithanian casters, the shields of Ursine vanguards, the golden blades of Sargonian assassins – he collected and modified the most valuable components of his enemies, and placed them upon his flagship.

raw: But not for the sake of commemoration. Only those who have become weak and frail through the passage of time need to rely on these vestiges to remember the past.
content: But not for the sake of commemoration. Only those who have become weak and frail through the passage of time need to rely on these vestiges to remember the past.

raw: The Gastrell must step over the bones of its enemies, assimilating their power so that it may become stronger.
content: The Gastrell must step over the bones of its enemies, assimilating their power so that it may become stronger.

raw: Only this way can the two of them defeat even stronger enemies together.
content: Only this way can the two of them defeat even stronger enemies together.

speaker: Sudaram
content: Intercept them!

speaker: Sudaram
content: The crystal barrier... has been shattered.

speaker: Sudaram
content: The enemy continues to advance.

raw: [name="Sudaram"]How they must long for death, using artillery fire to cleave a path.
speaker: Sudaram
content: How they must long for death, using artillery fire to cleave a path.

raw: Wave after wave of cannonfire pours down onto the sea of Originium.
content: Wave after wave of cannonfire pours down onto the sea of Originium.

raw: Golden fragments crack and split apart, revealing a gap within those congealed waves.
content: Golden fragments crack and split apart, revealing a gap within those congealed waves.

speaker: Sudaram
content: How dare they... approach us––

raw: A thick haze envelops the battleship.
content: A thick haze envelops the battleship.

raw: Countless Nachzehrer warriors land on its deck, the entire vessel enveloped in the glow of witchcraft.
content: Countless Nachzehrer warriors land on its deck, the entire vessel enveloped in the glow of witchcraft.
Rend, dismantle, corrode.

raw: The cadence of gunfire gradually slows.
content: The cadence of gunfire gradually slows.

raw: The hard, steel hull is being digested, just like all other prey that has fallen into the Nachzehrers' Arts circles.
content: The hard, steel hull is being digested, just like all other prey that has fallen into the Nachzehrers' Arts circles.

speaker: Sudaram
content: Capture... complete...

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Not yet.
He lifts his scepter.

raw: Branches grow rapidly from beneath the throne, blocking the front of the Nachzehrer warriors.
content: Branches grow rapidly from beneath the throne, blocking the front of the Nachzehrer warriors.

raw: A shell lodges within the branches.
content: A shell lodges within the branches.

raw: A few seconds later, the shell explodes, tearing the branches asunder.
content: A few seconds later, the shell explodes, tearing the branches asunder.

raw: For the first time since the battle began, the Nachzehrer's throne shakes.
content: For the first time since the battle began, the Nachzehrer's throne shakes.

speaker: Sudaram
content: My Patriarch!

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: It matters not.

raw: From the thick haze of corruption, the warship slowly comes into view.
content: From the thick haze of corruption, the warship slowly comes into view.

raw: Its outer layer flayed off by the corruption, almost half its main and secondary guns disabled due to the bombardment of witchcraft shells, only the steel frame remains shining.
content: Its outer layer flayed off by the corruption, almost half its main and secondary guns disabled due to the bombardment of witchcraft shells, only the steel frame remains shining.

raw: Yet she is nevertheless still Gastrell, the mightiest warship in the land.
content: Yet she is nevertheless still Gastrell, the mightiest warship in the land.
And her master–

raw: The Sarkaz atop the throne lowers his head, noticing a faint shadow among the crystal clusters.
content: The Sarkaz atop the throne lowers his head, noticing a faint shadow among the crystal clusters.

raw: [name="Redsteel Guard Member"]General, the Gastrell has successfully drawn the attention of the main Sarkaz force!
speaker: Redsteel Guard Member
content: General, the Gastrell has successfully drawn the attention of the main Sarkaz force!

raw: [name="Redsteel Guard Member"]They didn't even notice that we were transferred from the main ship–
speaker: Redsteel Guard Member
content: They didn't even notice that we were transferred from the main ship–

raw: [name="Redsteel Guard Member"]Wait, something's coming in fast!
speaker: Redsteel Guard Member
content: Wait, something's coming in fast!

speaker: Redsteel Guard Member
content: Guardsmen, tighten your formation!
A salvo of artillery fire.

raw: Only a few tiny twigs fall from the smoke and dust.
content: Only a few tiny twigs fall from the smoke and dust.

raw: The force that was enough to shatter those crystalline waves cannot even shake the figure floating in the air.
content: The force that was enough to shatter those crystalline waves cannot even shake the figure floating in the air.

raw: The Nachzehrer King casts his gaze down upon the commander at the center of the army. Not far behind the old Feline, the bloodthirsty warship is waiting, eager to tear at his rotting flesh.
content: The Nachzehrer King casts his gaze down upon the commander at the center of the army. Not far behind the old Feline, the bloodthirsty warship is waiting, eager to tear at his rotting flesh.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Duke... of Victoria.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]We have devoured many Victorians. General, Duke. Whatever the title, they all tasted the same.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: We have devoured many Victorians. General, Duke. Whatever the title, they all tasted the same.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Conspirators. Merchants. But none of their warriors.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Conspirators. Merchants. But none of their warriors.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]They saw the battlefield as little more than a sandbox atop a table. The soldiers, mere chess pieces; war itself, only a tool for power and profit. How frivolous war was to them.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: They saw the battlefield as little more than a sandbox atop a table. The soldiers, mere chess pieces; war itself, only a tool for power and profit. How frivolous war was to them.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]But, you are different. Your ship has also feasted on many enemies.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: But, you are different. Your ship has also feasted on many enemies.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Ursine. Leithanian. Gaulish... And, Sarkaz. I can smell their flesh.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Ursine. Leithanian. Gaulish... And, Sarkaz. I can smell their flesh.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]They have also been absorbed by the Nachzehrers.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: They have also been absorbed by the Nachzehrers.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Sarkaz... I've read plenty of records about you.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Sarkaz... I've read plenty of records about you.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]The ancient Nachzehrers, with a tenth of the Victorian Army's numbers, were able to halt their advance on Kazdel.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: The ancient Nachzehrers, with a tenth of the Victorian Army's numbers, were able to halt their advance on Kazdel.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]A feat of war that defies all reason, one that cannot be taught in military academies or replicated.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: A feat of war that defies all reason, one that cannot be taught in military academies or replicated.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Are you here to take revenge?

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Haha. My only regret is that I hadn't been born two hundred years ago.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Haha. My only regret is that I hadn't been born two hundred years ago.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]They apparently call you the 'God of War'?
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: They apparently call you the 'God of War'?

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]No. There are no gods when it comes to war.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: No. There are no gods when it comes to war.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]There only exists... the moment of victory or defeat.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: There only exists... the moment of victory or defeat.

raw: Wellington draws his sword and points it at the Sarkaz in midair.
content: Wellington draws his sword and points it at the Sarkaz in midair.

raw: Behind him, all the guns on his ship are pointed in the same direction.
content: Behind him, all the guns on his ship are pointed in the same direction.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Nezzsalem, I will defeat you.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Nezzsalem, I will defeat you.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Just like all the other mighty foes that have fallen at my hands.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Just like all the other mighty foes that have fallen at my hands.
